task: Adult vs developmental human brain gene expression reference for the gene tournament
integrity_note: sha256 is recomputed here from the file on disk and compared against the hash taken at the moment of download; sha256_stable must be true for every entry.

units_warning: GTEx is TPM on GENCODE v39; BrainSpan is RPKM on GENCODE v10. These are different units on different annotations from different pipelines. They are never divided, subtracted or otherwise combined numerically anywhere in this build.

not_obtained.item: GTEx individual-level / per-sample expression and exact donor ages
not_obtained.reason: Held in dbGaP under accession phs000424 and requires an authorized-access application with a signed Data Use Certificate and institutional signing official. That is a registration and a form submission, which this task is forbidden to perform. NOT ATTEMPTED.
not_obtained.consequence: Donor age is known only in 10-year brackets. No per-donor variance is available behind the GTEx medians, so no confidence interval can be put on any adult TPM value here.

not_obtained.item: GTEx v10 entry in the GTEx Portal fileList API (https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/dataset/fileList)
not_obtained.reason: The API's fileList response is stale: it enumerates releases up to v9 only and returns no v10 RNA-seq entries, and it returns no direct URLs at all. This is a defect in the portal API, not an access restriction.
not_obtained.consequence: The canonical v10 URL was instead confirmed directly against the official public GCS bucket listing (https://storage.googleapis.com/storage/v1/b/adult-gtex/o?prefix=bulk-gex/v10/rna-seq/), which is the bucket the portal's own downloads page serves from. Object name, byte count (8,846,936) and md5 were verified there before download.

not_obtained.item: Cell-type-resolved developmental expression (single-nucleus RNA-seq, e.g. PsychENCODE2 / BICAN / Velmeshev)
not_obtained.reason: Out of scope for this task and none of it is a small median-summary file; the relevant matrices are tens of GB and several require controlled access.
not_obtained.consequence: The bulk-vs-cell-type limitation recorded in the script docstring CANNOT be resolved with the data obtained here. PAX6 and RELN are worked examples in this very build: both are genuinely progenitor- or Cajal-Retzius-restricted, both are diluted in bulk homogenate, and both consequently classify as MIXED rather than as the developmentally-weighted genes they are known to be.

not_obtained.item: A DOI-bearing open mirror of BrainSpan (Zenodo / figshare)
not_obtained.reason: Not needed. The Allen Institute primary source was reachable directly with no registration, no account and no form, so the primary source was used. A third-party mirror would have weaker provenance and would not change the Allen Institute licence terms, which follow the data rather than the host.

not_obtained.item: Per-donor variance / replicate structure within BrainSpan age windows
not_obtained.reason: The summarised gene-level RPKM matrix is the smallest file that answers the question and carries no per-sample QC or variance summary.
not_obtained.consequence: Window means are unweighted means over samples, NOT over donors. Structures and donors contribute unequally: the adult window is 93 samples from only 6 donors, so a single unusual donor can move an adult mean. No standard error is computed anywhere in this build and none should be inferred.
